t: Made for handheld saws. Ideal for cutting hard wood, soft wood, plywood, chipboard and MDF. A specially formulated, highly compact Titanium Cobalt Carbide (TiCo). Provides a sharper edge and flawless finish with a longer cutting life. Perma shield technology is a non-stick coating formulation that withstands the toughest applications. Provides thermal insulation, protects from corrosion and eliminates resin build-up, reducing downtime for cleaning. Thin-kerf tooth design reduces friction and material removal for maximised battery runtime and effortless sawing.
b: Suitable for cutting Laminated Boards, Hardwood & Plastics
For use with Circular & Plunge Saws
Anti-Vibration Slots for Smooth Running & Minimised Noise
